In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.85 Å. In the sixth Na site, Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.49-2.79 Å. There are three inequivalent Nb sites. In the first Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 14-26°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.92-2.14 Å. In the second Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 16-25°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.92-2.13 Å. In the third Nb site, Nb is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing NbO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 14-23°. There are a spread of Nb-O bond distances ranging from 1.94-2.09 Å. There are twelve inequivalent O sites.
